description: This bar chart, titled "Recall@10", illustrates the performance metric Recall@10 for four different methods: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The horizontal axis lists these four categories in the order shown, while the vertical axis represents the Recall@10 score, ranging from 0.1 to 4.0 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The bars are colored distinctly: "Ours" is orange, and the other three methods are blue. The bar for "Ours" is the tallest, reaching approximately 3.8 on the y-axis, indicating the highest Recall@10 score among the four. The bar for "- critiquing" is the second tallest, reaching approximately 3.5. The bar for "- scoring" is the shortest, reaching approximately 0.25. The bar for "- ranking" reaches approximately 3.0. The bars are not sorted, and there is no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on any specific bar.
